title: TicketTriage
description: Structured classification of one customer support message, produced by the Triage agent.

intent.description: The main thing the customer wants.

order_id.description: Order ID if mentioned (format TC + 5 digits), otherwise null.

customer_email.description: Email address if the customer provided one, otherwise null.

language.description: Language of the message, e.g. English, Hindi, Hinglish.

needs_human.description: True if the customer is abusive, very angry, mentions legal action / consumer court / social media, or the request is suspicious.

route_to.description: support_agent for product/policy questions; order_ops_agent for anything about a specific order; human if needs_human is true.
